caption: Mean all-range R-precision by quartile of MSA depth over the 314 natural FoldBench monomers. Quartile boundaries are 784, 3,015 and 7,413 sequences; the set spans 2 to 19,393. MSA depth stands in for how many relatives a protein has — it correlates 0.80 with the number of homologs in our training corpus and 0.87 with KNN neighbour count.
